## Personality

Major Spencer is recognized as the most progressive individual in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). He is also known for being exceptionally public-spirited.

_Sources: [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P55](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0055)_

## History

Major Spencer is a resident of [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) mentioned during a discussion between [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md). He was involved in a past incident where he accidentally burned down his own house while attempting to burn out a wasp nest.

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 IX A Question of Color P2](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0002), [v2 IX A Question of Color P3](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0003), [v2 IX A Question of Color P4](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0004), [v2 IX A Question of Color P5](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0005), [v2 IX A Question of Color P6](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0006), +23 more_
